item.title: Model Context Protocol Docs
item.description:
The official home for the Model Context Protocol specification: how the handshake works, how tools and resources are defined, and reference documentation for building both clients and servers.

Start here if you want to understand MCP at the protocol level rather than just using pre-built servers from the directory.

item.title: MCP Builder
item.description: The MCP Builder skill packages the boilerplate and conventions for writing a new MCP server — the protocol handshake, tool and resource definitions, and error handling patterns that a well-behaved server needs.

item.title: Mercury MCP Cheatsheet
item.description:
This reference skill covers the Mercury (Proton) MCP tools for messaging agent teammates, managing threads, and scheduling automations across a coordinated team of agents.

Why a skill for this

Multi-agent coordination tools tend to have enough surface area — threading, scheduling, teammate addressing — that a quick reference beats re-deriving the API each time. This skill keeps that reference on hand.
